payload.title: Windows setup hangs at the add to user PATH step

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- The add to user PATH command returns without waiting for the environment broadcast
- Every powershell launch in terminal_setup passes -NoProfile

payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger
When a customer runs the install.ps1 one-liner, setup stops at the add to user PATH step, so I want that step to finish without waiting on other windows, so I can install on any Windows machine.

## Cause
SendMessageTimeout with HWND_BROADCAST waits up to the timeout for each top-level window (Microsoft Learn, SendMessageTimeoutA). The 5000 ms timeout times many slow windows blocks setup once per added directory. The PATH update and WezTerm install also loaded the user profile (no -NoProfile).

## Scope
- `terminal_setup/prerequisites.py`
- `tests/test_terminal_setup/test_prerequisites.py`
- `changelog.d/**`

payload.title: Claude Code statusline missing after a customer install

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value: - The cause is named from the customer output

payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger
When a customer finished the install.ps1 one-liner on a fresh WSL Ubuntu 24.04 machine, Claude Code showed no statusline until the customer asked Claude to set it, so I want setup to set it on every supported shell, so I can use the statusline right after install.

## Known
- deploy_claude_statusline writes statusLine to the Windows and the WSL ~/.claude/settings.json; both are set on the owner machine.
- It skips Windows without Git Bash, WSL without jq, a missing ~/.claude, and invalid settings JSON, each with an info or WARN line.
- The same customer run hung at the add to user PATH step (term-n9i7ur); an aborted run never reaches the configuration step.

## Needed
The customer setup output from the Deploying configuration step, or the --only report output.

payload.name: requirements
payload.value: - Setup sets the Claude Code statusline for PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL and WezTerm

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value: - The WSL statusline script finds jq in ~/.local/bin

payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger
When a customer finished the install.ps1 one-liner on a fresh WSL Ubuntu 24.04 machine, Claude Code had ~/.claude/statusline.sh but no statusLine setting, so I want setup to write the setting in WSL, so I can see the statusline right after install.

## Cause
Setup installs jq into ~/.local/bin in WSL. The WSL statusline script runs through wsl -d <distro> --exec sh, whose PATH has no ~/.local/bin, so command -v jq fails and the script skips settings.json with a WARN. Reproduced on Ubuntu-24.04: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-24.04 --exec sh -c 'command -v jq' prints nothing.

## Scope
- `terminal_setup/configs.py`
- `tests/test_terminal_setup/**`
- `changelog.d/**`

payload.text: [session handover 2026-10-27] STATE: basicly upgraded to v0.29.0 (term-xxvycv). Fixed the missing WSL statusLine: wsl --exec sh had no ~/.local/bin, so jq was not found (term-ktjvv2). Added a Start menu entry and a location line for the per-user WezTerm install (term-3ssu8z). Released v0.17.0. NEXT: e2e-install for v0.17.0 was still running at handover; the owner runs the PowerShell install check on a fresh WSL machine. term-bzfgkl (old basicly v0.25.1 upgrade) is superseded by term-xxvycv and can be closed after review.
